notes: *set up* is kept as one unit headed on *set*, but note that ἵστημι carries no preverb, so rule 106 is not literally the licence: *up* is part of the English expression the ASV spends on the verb and belongs to its unit under rule 2. The head is unaffected.

Three articles, three routes: s006 and s014 are emptied by rule 38, the demonstratives οὗτος and τούτου occupying the determiner slots, and s016 is the second attributive article `unrepresented` under rule 23. Only one *this* is written, on the demonstrative, and it is not split.
λαλῶν keeps its own infinitival *to* under rules 7 and 61, no conjunction governing the complement clause; οὐ is aligned to *not* in the ordinary way, no negative indefinite standing.
v007 selected r01, which carries τούτου, so *this* before *holy place* is aligned rather than `added`.
